notes: Trimmed "grow warm/tender" pairing to "grow warm" per the tightened compound-gloss standard: Hos.11.8/Lam.5.10 show physical/emotional warming, and "tender" is a synonym of that, not a separate sense; "yearn" (1Kgs.3.26/Gen.43.30) is a genuinely different, independently-cited sense and stays.
